name: io.github.Nero-Engine/listing-location-toolkit
title: Listing Location Toolkit
description: Listing and home buyer facts: drive times, people reached, schools, shops, flood, crime.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Free. Lists every tool, the data sources and licences, the coverage (US and UK) and the limits. No inputs.

tools.name: listing_location_pack
tools.description: Everything for one address in one call: drive times to the nearest town, cities and airports; people living within a 1, 2 and 4 hour drive (US Census 2020 or WorldPop 2020 UK); nearby lakes, rivers, coast, mountains, national parks and attractions with distances and drive minutes; waterfront and inside-a-national-park checks; the mapped site outline and its size in acres and hectares; and map links (US aerial photo). Returns listing_lines (short sentences to paste into a listing), the raw numbers, and sources with licences. Takes 10 to 25 seconds.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

hours.description: Drive bands in hours for the people count. Default [1, 2, 4]. Up to 4 bands, each 0.25 to 5.

radius_miles.description: How far to look for nature and attractions. Default 20, max 40.

destinations.description: Optional extra places to time, as names ("Albany, NY") or {name, lat, lon}. Up to 6.

tools.name: home_buyer_report
tools.description: Everything a home buyer asks about one address, in one call: nearby primary, middle, secondary and private schools (England: Ofsted grades or report cards, pupils, faith, selective; US: grades, pupils per teacher, free lunch share, and the school district the address is in), how admissions and catchments work there, everyday places (supermarket, doctor, pharmacy, dentist, station, bus stop, park, playground, library, gym, cafe, pub, EV charger) with walk and drive minutes, a 15 minute walk check, the neighbourhood (US census tract income, home value, rent, owners, households with children, commute, against county and US; England deprivation deciles; England and Wales sale prices by property type for the postcode sector), flood zone (FEMA in the US, Environment Agency in England) and street crime for the latest month (England, Wales and Northern Ireland). Returns listing_lines, the raw data and sources. Takes 10 to 25 seconds.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

tools.name: schools_nearby
tools.description: Nearest schools by level (primary, middle, secondary, private, special, nursery) with miles, walk and drive minutes. England: every open school from the DfE register with the latest Ofsted grade or report card, type, ages, pupils, gender, faith and selective flag. US: every public school from NCES 2024-25 (grades, pupils, pupils per teacher, charter, free lunch share, district) and private schools, plus the school district the address is in from Census boundaries, with in_your_school_district on each public school. Wales, Scotland and NI: OpenStreetMap schools. Explains how catchments and admissions work for the address. There is no national catchment map in the UK or US: the answer says who decides.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

per_level.description: Schools per level. Default 3 to 5, max 10.

max_miles.description: Furthest school to list. Default 10, max 25.

drive_minutes.description: Add drive minutes (one router call). Default true.

tools.name: daily_needs
tools.description: Everyday places near an address from OpenStreetMap, in five groups: groceries (supermarket, corner shop), health (doctor or GP, pharmacy, dentist, hospital), getting around (train, metro, tram, bus, EV charging), kids and family (playground, park, childcare, library, sports centre) and out and about (cafe, pub, restaurant, gym, dog park, golf, post office). For each: the nearest with miles, walk minutes and (for the key ones) drive minutes, and how many are within a 15 minute walk. Includes a 15 minute walk check out of 7 everyday needs. US and UK.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

tools.name: area_profile
tools.description: Who lives around an address. US: census tract median household income, home value, rent, median age, owner-occupied share, households with children, commute under 30 minutes, degree share and median year built (ACS 2020-2024), with the county, state and US figures to compare, plus county, place, ZIP and school district. UK: council, ward, constituency, rural or urban class and national park; England deprivation deciles (overall, income, employment, education, health, crime, housing, living environment, children); England and Wales median sale prices by property type for the postcode sector over the last 12 months (HM Land Registry).

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

tools.name: flood_risk
tools.description: Flood zone at the exact point. US: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer zone (A, AE, V and so on mean high risk, where lenders usually require flood insurance; shaded X moderate). England: Environment Agency Flood Zone 1, 2 or 3 from rivers and the sea. Wales, Scotland and NI: a link to their own flood map. Returns a plain listing line and the official checker link.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

tools.name: crime_nearby
tools.description: Crimes and anti-social behaviour recorded by police within 1 mile of an address in the latest published month (data.police.uk, England, Wales and Northern Ireland), by type, with the count within 400 m. Central London falls back to a quarter mile. US: says plainly that no free national crime data by address exists and where to look.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

tools.name: who_can_reach
tools.description: How many people live within each drive time of an address, for example 1, 2 and 4 hours. US: 2020 Census block group populations. UK: WorldPop 2020 1 km grid. Drive times from the OSRM router on OpenStreetMap roads (minutes scaled to match Google Maps usual traffic). Returns the count per band, a ready listing sentence, the method and sources. US and UK only; people across a border (Canada, Mexico, Ireland, France) are not counted.

tools.name: drive_times
tools.description: Drive minutes and road miles from an address to up to 20 places. Give destinations as names ("Utica, NY", "Manchester Airport") or {name, lat, lon}; leave them out to get the nearest town, nearest big cities and nearest airports automatically. OSRM router on OpenStreetMap roads, scaled to match Google Maps usual-traffic minutes. Returns rows plus ready listing lines.

tools.name: nearby_nature
tools.description: Notable named places near an address, grouped: lakes and reservoirs, rivers, coast and beaches, islands, mountains, national parks, parks and nature reserves, golf, ski and marinas, museums and attractions. Each with miles, direction and (by default) drive minutes. Says when the site is on the water or inside a national park, measured from the real OpenStreetMap outline. Source Wikidata (CC0). US and UK.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

categories.description: Limit to these groups. Default all.

drive_minutes.description: Add drive minutes to the closest places (one router call). Default true.

tools.name: plot_size
tools.description: Area of a site in acres, hectares, square feet and square metres, plus its perimeter. Pass a polygon (from a county parcel map, a deed plan or a drawing) for an exact figure, or just an address or lat and lon to measure the OpenStreetMap outline of the place at that point (for example a campground, marina or hotel grounds). An OpenStreetMap outline is not a legal boundary: say "about" and check it against the deed.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

polygon.description: Optional. A GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon (or a Feature holding one), or a plain list of [lon, lat] points. Up to 5,000 points.

tools.name: map_image
tools.description: Links for a listing map: a US aerial photo of the site as a PNG (USGS National Map imagery, public domain, any width from 100 m to 5 km), a USGS topo map PNG, and Google Maps and OpenStreetMap links. In the UK only the map links are returned for now. Instant, no outside calls.
